## Critical Patterns

- **Eager load + Resource = atomic pair**: When adding a relation to `->with([...])` in a service, always add the matching `whenLoaded()` in the Resource class. Missing it silently omits the data from API responses.
- **InfoWindow must be a sibling of AdvancedMarker**: In `@vis.gl/react-google-maps`, children of `AdvancedMarker` render as custom pin HTML, not InfoWindow balloons. Always render `InfoWindow` after the marker, never nested inside it.
- **CSS `background` shorthand overrides Tailwind `bg-*`**: Custom CSS classes that use `background:` shorthand reset `background-color`, defeating Tailwind utilities like `bg-primary`. Use `background-image:` instead for overlay-only gradient classes.
- **Use `morphMap()` not `enforceMorphMap()` in existing projects**: `enforceMorphMap()` requires ALL polymorphic relationships to be registered or it throws. Existing projects using Spatie Media Library or HasAddress will break. Always use `Relation::morphMap()` when adding new morphable models to an existing codebase.
- **MySQL ENUM columns reject out-of-set factory values in tests**: Factories generating arbitrary strings for ENUM columns cause data truncation errors. Always constrain factory `randomElement()` to the exact ENUM values defined in the migration.
